## Description and Rationale

I’m an AI engineer with a strong interest in aviation and data-driven approaches to improving airport operations. I decided to join the PRC Challenge because it combines two areas I’m passionate about: machine learning and aviation. I’m particularly interested in exploring how flight and airport data can be used to better predict taxi-out times and understand operational constraints.
